description:
HushThreads v0.0.18 has 26 patches for Threads 455.0.0.55.72 (com.instagram.barcelona).

This release moves to Threads 455 on all nine APKMirror variants and to Morphe patcher 2.3.0, so update Threads and Morphe Manager before you patch. New Spoof SIM region, Full size profile pictures, Change package name and Change app name patches, and a switch that hides the suggested threads under a post you open.

Validation: 1106 runtime tests passed locally. All 346 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 26 patches applied to Threads 455.0.0.55.72 without forcing, and the release receipt records the run.

Needs Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Threads 455.0.0.55.72. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Threads APK. Uninstall the stock Threads first, and keep the manager's signing key for updates.

### Changes

* Meta's own Instagram won't open Threads posts in HushThreads, and the note about it under Links in HushThreads settings now tells you what to do instead. Patch Instagram with HushGram in the same Morphe Manager so both share one key, and Instagram opens Threads posts and profiles right in HushThreads. Asked about in #8.
* New `Spoof SIM region` patch. Threads sees a SIM and network from the country you pick, with one of that country's real carriers, instead of your own. There are 69 countries to choose from. It starts off, so turn it on and pick one in HushThreads settings > Privacy. Meta can still go by your connection and your account, so it won't hide where you are by itself. Asked for in #25.
* HushThreads now patches Threads 455.0.0.55.72 only, on all nine APKMirror variants (arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64 and x86). Update Threads to 455 before you patch. v0.0.17 is the last release for 454.0.0.54.79.
* Hide ads and Hide suggested users keep up with how Threads 455 stores For You. It writes every page and every single post straight into the feed cache now, and it can slip an ad into a page you're already scrolling. All of those go through the filters, and a page keeps its posts as they were when an ad gets turned away.
* Hide suggested users also takes the suggested threads off the bottom of a post you open. It has its own switch, `Hide suggested threads`, under the other two on the Feed page, and it starts on. The post and its replies stay. Asked for in #24.
* New `Full size profile pictures` patch. When you open someone's profile picture on their profile, it shows full size in a viewer of its own instead of Threads' small circle. You can pinch to zoom, and with Save media on there's a Save button too. It's in Manager's default selection, but its switch under Appearance in HushThreads settings starts off. Asked for in #22.
* The bundle is built on Morphe patcher 2.3.0 now, the one that comes with Morphe Manager 2.5.0 and Morphe Desktop 2.1.0. Older Manager builds can't load it, so update Manager to 2.5.0 or newer first.
* With `Show exact post times` on and a large font, a post's time stays in one piece. Under a long name it used to break after the month or the day, with "Nov" on one line and "5, 2:30 AM" on the next. Now the whole time moves under the name when it doesn't fit beside it.
* New `Change package name` and `Change app name` patches. Keep your regular Threads and install HushThreads next to it as a second app with its own sign-in. Neither patch is in Manager's default selection. HushThreads settings show the copy's package name and app name under Set when you patched. Asked for in #23.

patches.name: Block background-return feed refresh
patches.description: Keeps your place in your feed when you leave Threads and come back within ten minutes. Pulling down to refresh still loads new posts. Good if you hate losing the post you were reading. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches.name: Change app name
patches.description: Changes the name under the app's icon, so a copy you install beside Threads with Change package name is easy to tell apart. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

options.description: The name under the app's icon, up to 30 characters.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Gives the patched Threads its own package name, so it installs beside the Threads you already have instead of over it. It's a separate app with its own sign-in. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

options.description: The copy's package name. Each copy needs its own.

patches.name: Change version code
patches.description: Raises the version number as high as Android allows, so Google Play won't offer Meta's updates over it. Going back to stock Threads means uninstalling, which deletes its data. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops Threads from sending most of its usage reports to Meta. A few may still get through. Good if you'd rather share less about how you use the app. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable screenshot detection
patches.description: Threads isn't told when you take a screenshot. It stops watching your photos for new screenshots. Good if you want to screenshot without Threads noticing. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable swipe to Search
patches.description: Stops a sideways swipe on your feed from sliding into Search. The Search button still opens Search. Threads only has the swipe on some accounts. Good if you keep landing in Search while you scroll. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches.name: Disable video autoplay
patches.description: Videos in your feed wait for a tap instead of playing as you scroll. Good for a calmer feed and less data use. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches.name: Filter comments
patches.description: Leaves out the replies to a post that match words or domains you list, such as the shop link a spam reply ends with, before Threads shows them. A second switch under it also hides any reply with a web link. The replies that stay keep their order. Starts off. Turn it on and add your list in HushThreads settings > Comments.

patches.name: Full size profile pictures
patches.description: Opens a profile picture full size when you tap it on a profile, so you can zoom in and save it, instead of Threads' small circle. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Appearance.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored posts from your feed and from under the posts you open before Threads shows them, so they leave no gap. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide ghost post bubbles
patches.description: Takes the ghost post bubbles off profile pictures, on profiles and in the row at the top of your feed. The pictures and the ghost posts themselves stay. Good for a calmer look. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Appearance.

patches.name: Hide suggested users
patches.description: Removes the cards that suggest accounts to follow, in your feed and on profiles, the Follow suggestions row in Search and the suggested threads under a post you open. Normal posts and reposts stay, and so do a post's replies and the rest of a profile or Search. Good if you only want posts in your feed. On by default. Its three switches are in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide the Instagram button
patches.description: Takes the Instagram button off the top of profiles, yours and other people's. The other buttons stay. Good for a tidier profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Appearance.

patches.name: HushThreads settings
patches.description: Adds a HushThreads page to Threads where you turn features on or off, pause HushThreads, back up your settings and read the licenses. Open it from Threads' own settings, or long-press the Threads logo at the top of your feed. Works as soon as you patch it in. Each way in has its own switch under Pause, backup and diagnostics, and the last one that's on stays on.

patches.name: Max image quality
patches.description: Loads photos at the largest size Threads has, instead of one picked for your screen. Photos look sharper but use more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches.name: Open links in browser
patches.description: Opens links you tap in your regular browser instead of inside Threads, and skips Threads' link tracking. Threads, Instagram and other Meta pages still open in Threads. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Pure black dark mode
patches.description: Makes Threads' dark mode truly black instead of dark gray behind your feed and posts. It looks deeper and can save battery on OLED screens. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Appearance.

patches.name: Remove share targets
patches.description: Takes Threads out of the share menu in other apps, so it isn't offered when you share a link, photo or video. Sharing from Threads still works. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Remove the advertising ID
patches.description: Stops Threads from reading your phone's advertising ID. It gets a string of zeros instead. Good for making your phone harder to track across apps. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches.description: Fixes Threads screens that fail on a patched app because they check who signed it. Also lets Threads share sign-in with an Instagram signed with this build's key, and makes the share sheet's tiles open patched Meta apps. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Removes tracking tags from links you copy or share from Threads, and turns short share links into the post's own link. The link still opens the same post. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Save photos and videos
patches.description: Adds Save to a post's menu, below Copy link. It saves the photo or video to your gallery, every page of a carousel too, and on a text post it saves the video that post links or quotes. Good for keeping posts you like. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Show exact post times
patches.description: Posts and replies show the date and time they went up instead of 3h or 2d, in your phone's 12 or 24-hour format. Good if you want to know exactly when something was posted. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Posts.

patches.name: Spoof SIM region
patches.description: Threads sees a SIM and network from a country you pick, with one of that country's real carriers, instead of your own. Meta can still go by your connection and your account. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Trust user-added certificates
patches.description: Lets Threads accept security certificates you installed yourself, such as for a work network or a debugging proxy. Meta's own checks stay, so a proxy can't read most traffic. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

Four new patches. `Spoof SIM region` lets Threads see a SIM from a country you pick, and `Full size profile pictures` opens someone's profile picture in a viewer of its own. `Change package name` and `Change app name` put HushThreads next to your regular Threads as a second app. The suggested threads under a post you open can go now too.

**Your reports in this release**

- [#8](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads/issues/8) found that Meta's own Instagram won't open Threads posts in HushThreads. The note under Links in HushThreads settings points to the way round it now, which is patching Instagram with HushGram in the same Morphe Manager.
- [#22](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads/issues/22) asked to see a profile picture full size. `Full size profile pictures` opens it in its own viewer with pinch to zoom, and with Save media on there's a Save button too.
- [#23](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads/issues/23) asked for a way to keep the regular Threads and have HushThreads beside it. `Change package name` and `Change app name` do that, and the copy has its own sign-in.
- [#24](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads/issues/24) asked to hide the suggested threads under a post's replies. `Hide suggested threads` on the Feed page takes them away, and it starts on.
- [#25](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads/issues/25) asked to change the region Threads sees. Turn on `Spoof SIM region` under Privacy and pick a country, and Threads reads that country's SIM and carrier instead of yours.

## Tooling

- The full patch check, which applies every patch, passes with `Change package name` in the bundle. It used to read the renamed package and its renamed permissions as an unknown app asking for new permissions. The checks that compare a patched build with the clean one follow Threads 455 too, where three of the places they read had moved.

## Update

1. You need [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 2.5.0 or newer. If HushThreads is already one of your patch sources, Manager shows 0.0.18 once it refreshes. If it isn't, add it: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushThreads
2. Get Threads 455.0.0.55.72 for your phone (arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64 or x86) and patch that. v0.0.17 was the last release for Threads 454.
3. Manager's default selection has every patch except `Change package name`, `Change app name`, `Change version code`, `Remove share targets` and `Trust user-added certificates`. Turn on Expert mode if you want any of those.
4. Patch with the Morphe Manager signing key you used last time. That's what lets the update install over your patched Threads and keep your data and your login. Coming from the stock Threads, uninstall it first, or patch with `Change package name` to keep both.
5. On a fresh install, sign in with your Instagram username and password.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Threads APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads#install).

## Validation

1106 runtime tests and 346 patch tests passed locally, along with both Android lints and the release script checks. All 26 patches applied without forcing to Threads 455.0.0.55.72, and the release receipt records the run. The dependency advisory check passed.
